source.note: "Create a project access token" example response; the page abbreviates its token ("D4y...Wzr"). The token here is adapted to the routable format a GitLab 19.5.8 self-managed instance measurably answered on 2026-11-26: 53 characters, the glpat- prefix, only [A-Za-z0-9_.-], and dots at indices 40 and 43 (glpat- + 34 + .01. + 9 base36). The value is fake and carries the FAKE marker (BD-002). The layout is described by GitLab's routable-token design document (SOURCES.md). A separate project path (acme/routed) keeps it from turning acme/api's mint into a sequence.
